messages:
marco: Heads up — PR #10234 is passing CI but we should not merge yet. Needs architecture sign-off and the RFC link attached. Can someone paste the RFC and a 1–2 line safety summary?
ashley: @marco could you drop the PR link? also what is the proposed rollout window?
marco: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/10234
marco: rollout wants to be next Tue 08:00-10:00 PT if arch + sec ok.
jen: pinging arch team — we need the RFC URL and a quick note on expected SLO delta and cold-start impact.
ashley: small ask — add a short migration plan in the PR description (steps + rollback command). Eg: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/gateway` and how to check kv-cache warming.
dave: arch-bot: please run lightweight architecture checklist? :robot_face:
arch-bot: @dave running checklist: requirements attached: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcdRFC-checklist — missing: "capacity plan" and "fallback model mapping" entries.
marco: thanks — the RFC is at https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ZkRFC-serve-design. I'll add a one-paragraph safety summary to the PR describing fallback policy and data isolation.
jen: for the SLOs: expect 5–8% p50 latency increase under cold start, 0% steady-state. Include that in the RFC summary.
ashley: can someone confirm there are no user-facing schema changes? I don't want a client rollback during canary.
marco: no schema changes. only serving routing and kv-cache tuning.
dave: ack. once marco adds the RFC link + safety blurb I'll do a quick code review and approve if checklist items are filled.
marco: added RFC link + safety summary to PR and updated description with rollout steps and rollback command.
jen: quick note — ops team will need a runbook snippet for the fallback route. marco can you add a single-line command for ops to trigger fallback?
marco: added `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood-internal/fallback -d '{"route":"serve-v1"}'` as the rollback trigger in the PR body.
ashley: thanks — canary window still ok for Tue morning. I’ll reserve the slot with releases. :thumbsup:
dave: running final lgtm now. If arch-bot check passes and no objections from security, I’ll merge after the canary window starts.
arch-bot: architecture checklist complete: capacity plan ok; fallback mapping present; kv-cache warming note added.
jen: security ok — no new data exfil risk identified.
marco: great, thanks everyone. Will stand by during Tue canary and post metrics to the release thread.
ashley: perfect — merge gated on canary start. Leaving this thread open for any late blockers.
